name: Backgammon
tagline: Play the computer on this device, or a friend from one link. No server.
description:
The computer thinks on this device. There is no game server. Pass the phone, or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same table, live, on two devices. The game lives in the file, so sharing the GIF shares the board.

A table of twenty-four points. White and black take turns rolling two dice and moving their fifteen checkers toward home. Hit a blot, it goes to the bar. Bear them all off and you win. Doubles are four moves. There is no doubling cube. White goes first. Roll, tap a checker, tap where it goes, confirm the turn.

An unofficial port of backgammonjs by quasoft. The rules are the same general table that shipped with that game.
